agent-memory.note: Agent Memory MCP. Registers persistent global/project memory tools (setup/list/query/recall/save/update/inspect/delete/link/unlink plus graph/path/prune). Project-scoped tools accept an absolute workspace_root when the MCP server cwd differs from the repo. Inspect a store visually with npx -y @wiolett/agent-memory@latest view. Configure model access with npx -y @wiolett/agent-memory@latest init.
